<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 193.1103 likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral mass of ~192.103 Da. Considering isotopic pattern (~12 % M+1) suggests ~11 C atoms. The formula C₁₁H₁₄NO₂ matches this neutral mass (192.1025 Da) within <1 mDa and fits the isotopic intensity. Therefore the molecular formula is C₁₁H₁₄O₂N.</thought>
<final_answer>C11H14O2N</final_answer>
